verdict.rationale: Marqeta supports event-driven automation via webhooks that notify external systems of API events, and it offers configurable velocity/authorization controls that automatically enforce spend rules (limits, merchant restrictions) when transaction events occur, plus JIT funding logic where a system approves/denies based on custom business rules. However, this is not a general-purpose 'define your own trigger-action rules' engine — it's a fixed set of control types and webhook notifications, requiring the developer to build the actual action logic themselves. Missing for 10: a native no-code/if-this-then-that rule builder, evidence of arbitrary custom trigger-action workflows beyond spend controls, and independent confirmation of automation reliability.
